fieldValues.title: Heading-field carriage discriminator: effective_fields, never value_str().is_none()
fieldValues.summary: In render_service.rs's titleFieldId/identityFieldId heading resolution (RFC-020 [N+37]), 'this record's Type doesn't carry the declared titleFieldId' and 'the record left the field's value empty' are indistinguishable by looking at the record's own field value alone — both read as absent. The only correct discriminator is Package::effective_fields(record_type): carried-but-empty must omit the heading with no fallback; not-carried must fall back to identityFieldId. Any future change to this resolution ladder (or a similar carried-value-vs-declared-field problem elsewhere in the renderer) must check field carriage, not value presence.
fieldValues.rationale: Getting this wrong either loses the empty-value-omission guarantee (silently promoting an unrelated identityFieldId value into a heading whenever an author leaves a title blank) or reintroduces srs-rust#1011's original bug (never falling back for a genuinely absent field). The fix's own test suite locks both directions: heading_omitted_when_type_has_title_field_but_record_value_empty must never regress into a fallback, and title_field_id_omitted_silently_for_record_lacking_field must never regress into a silent omission. Reopen only if RFC-020's [N+37]/[N+1] rules themselves change (Door 2/3, not a local refactor).
